```{r}
#| echo: false

here::i_am("Data-management-project-Saihou-kate.Rproj")

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Import datasets
credit <- read.csv(
  "bis_dp_custom_table_export_20261114-214619.csv",
  skip = 3
)

gdp <- read.csv(
  "GDP (constant_ 2015 _US$).csv",
  skip = 4
)

CPI <- read.csv(
  "Consumer price index (2010 = 100).csv",
  skip = 4
)

GDP_Growth <- read.csv(
  "GDP growth (annual %).csv",
  skip = 4
)

Trade_Openness <- read.csv(
  "Trade-Percentage-GDP.csv",
  skip = 4
)

Unemployment_rate <- read.csv(
  "Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate).csv",
  skip = 4
)
```

## Transform GDP data

```{r}
#| echo: false

gdp_long <- gdp |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "GDP"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform CPI data

```{r}
CPI_long <- CPI |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "CPI"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform GDP_growth data

```{r}
gdp_Growth_long <- GDP_Growth |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "GDP_Growth"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform Trade Openness data

```{r}
Trade_Openness_long <- gdp |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Trade_Openness"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(sub("^X", "", Year)))
```

## Transform credit data

```{r}
credit_long <- credit |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "debt_GDP_ratio"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = sub("^X", "", Year))
```

## Transform Umemployment data

```{r}
Unemployment_long <- Unemployment_rate |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "Umemployment_rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = sub("^X", "", Year))
```

## Calculate annual average credit-to-GDP ratio from quarterly data

```{r}
library(lubridate)

credit_annual <- credit_long |>
  mutate(Year = year(as.Date(Year, format = "%Y.%m.%d"))) |>
  group_by(Borrowers..country, Year) |>
  summarise(
    debt_GDP_ratio = mean(debt_GDP_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


## Rename country column
```{r}
credit_annual<-credit_annual |> 
  rename(Country.Name= Borrowers..country)
```


## conver Years into intergers
```{r}
gdp_long <- gdp_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

gdp_Growth_long <- gdp_Growth_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

Trade_Openness_long <- Trade_Openness_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

Unemployment_long <- Unemployment_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

CPI_long <- CPI_long |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))
```



## Merge GDP and credit data

```{r}
Merged_data <- credit_annual |>
  inner_join(
    gdp_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, GDP),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    gdp_Growth_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, GDP_Growth),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    Trade_Openness_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, Trade_Openness),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    Unemployment_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, Umemployment_rate),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    CPI_long |> select(Country.Name, Year, CPI),
    by = c("Country.Name", "Year")
  )
```

##  merged dataset Inspection

```{r}
nrow(Merged_data)
str(Merged_data)
summary(Merged_data)
colSums(is.na(Merged_data))
sum(is.na(gdp_long$GDP))

n_distinct(Merged_data$Country.Name)
```


### test correlation 

```{r}
Merged_data |>
  filter(Year == 2011) |>
  summarise(
    correlation = cor(GDP_Growth,
      debt_GDP_ratio,
      use = "complete.obs"
    )
  )
```


```{r}
Cor_table<-Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year %in% 2000:2015) |>
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(correlation = cor(GDP_Growth,debt_GDP_ratio, use = "complete.obs"))

Cor_table

```

### Correlation graph
```{r}
Merged_data |> 
  filter(Year == 2011) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=GDP_Growth, y = debt_GDP_ratio))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE)

```
